scenes.narration: A self-hosted runner does one job at a time. Your queue waits its turn, and whatever one job leaves behind, the next one inherits.

scenes.visual: Motion Canvas: new scene, one job becoming one fresh VM
scenes.narration: kinhin is a free, open-source Mac app. It watches your queue, starts a fresh VM or container for each job, and deletes it when the job is done.

Jobs arrive, and kinhin scales to the queue, within your Mac's limits. Each job gets its own clean instance. When one fails, the next still starts on a clean machine. Then every instance is deleted. Nothing lingers.
It works with GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo, on Tart, apple container, or Docker, routed per repo, workflow, or runs-on label.
Install with one line. Then kinhin doctor checks your Mac.
One job. One VM. Gone when it's done. kinhin dot dev. Free, Apache 2, no telemetry, and in beta.
